correctness.rationale: The Jacobian dependency VH=0 with a hollow symmetric H forces rank(V)<=1; the nonzero rank-one coefficient system has determinant (up to sign) 2 alpha beta gamma, yielding exactly three critical determinantal cones. Their images are three coordinate axes. Xie [1] establishes every-fiber CI and flatness for h=3,M>=3. On any punctured target axis, q(v1)!=0 and the algebraic orthogonal splitting gives the exact residual hypersurface equation B(w2,w3)=0 in two copies of a rank M-1 nondegenerate bundle. Its Jacobian scheme is the reduced zero section and its Hessian has rank 2M-2 at every point. The finite F3 rank-exhaustion and Hessian checker supports, but cannot prove, the all-M statement.

value.rationale: An FRS theorem does not locate where its fibers fail smoothness; the exact discriminant controls the maximal target open over which the morphism is smooth, an intrinsic geometric invariant of this recent arithmetic-geometric family. On its punctured critical-value strata, the entire singular scheme and transverse analytic germ are determined in all dimensions, not just a sample or generic point. The degeneration from a unique smooth irreducible singular stratum over a punctured axis to the previously studied multi-component zero-fiber geometry gives a motivated boundary phenomenon. The resulting classification is a natural structural extension, not a renaming or finite-table recomputation.
